contract.title: ERA5 hourly data on single levels
contract.intent: Explore a small ERA5 single-level reanalysis pull before planning a larger climate-data pipeline.
contract.summary: ERA5 single levels is a global gridded reanalysis dataset available through the Copernicus Climate Data Store. This draft keeps the first request small: one or two surface variables, a short recent date range, a coarse timestep, and one user-selected area.
access_methods: CDS API using local CDS credentials
defaults_used: Short recent date range, at most 7 days
One bounded area instead of global extraction
NetCDF output for downstream data engineering
assumptions: The first workflow should avoid global, hourly, multi-variable extraction.
The user will choose the bounding area before pipeline planning.
Recent data availability and final ERA5 versus ERA5T policy should be checked before production use.
risks_or_unknowns: CDS terms must be accepted by the account before automated download.
Large requests can queue or fail, so the first pipeline should stay intentionally small.
The source dataset has many variables; this contract intentionally selects only a minimal starting subset.

evidence.title: ERA5 hourly data on single levels

evidence.note: Official guidance for local CDS API credentials.

advanced_options.full_variable_inventory: Keep out of the default user flow; expose later through search or advanced controls.
